record.longDescription:
The 180 ECTS DBA in Business Administration program equips business students, managers, practitioners, and leaders with advanced knowledge, research capabilities, and analytical skills to address complex organizational challenges. Unlike other advanced programs, this DBA emphasizes the application of theoretical concepts to practical business issues, fostering transformative learning and enhanced research proficiency. Participants develop the ability to view business scenarios from innovative perspectives and apply research methodologies to devise solutions that promote organizational growth, efficiency, and long-term sustainability.

This flexible and rigorous program is delivered entirely online, allowing students to progress at their own pace. Depending on their chosen pathway—Coursework or Research—students typically complete the program within three years. However, research-focused candidates may achieve their qualification in less than three years.

The DBA program emphasizes applied research, enabling participants to implement their learning directly into their organizational contexts. The curriculum is designed to develop critical skills, including research proficiency, analytical thinking, effective communication, presentation techniques, and leadership in change management.

After completing the program, students will have the ability to:

Develop qualitative and quantitative research skills essential for doctoral-level investigations.

Apply effective strategies for managing human resources in complex organizational settings.

Analyze and address competitive challenges using strategic management frameworks.

Explore the evolution of business theories and their application to contemporary practices.

Master principles of asset valuation, risk diversification, and financial risk mitigation.

Evaluate individual and group behaviours to optimize organizational performance.

Enhance leadership, communication, and motivation skills for strategic management success.
record.courseDetails:
The course is delivered in two segments. Segment 1 consists of Seven modules, each one with an assignment and Segment 2 consists of a RESEARCH REPORT(paper) Segment 1:

Modules: You will be awarded a level 8 Diploma for the completion of the coursework of the following modules.

Advanced Research Methods:

This module equips students with essential qualitative and quantitative research principles for doctoral-level studies. It covers theoretical concepts such as research philosophy and approach, alongside practical methods like research strategy, data collection, and analysis. Ethical research practices are emphasized to ensure sound decision-making throughout the doctoral process.

Advanced Human Resource Management:Focused on managing human capital in complex organizations, this module covers recruitment, training, promotion, and motivation strategies. It aims to enhance individual contributions, foster employee loyalty, and improve operational efficiency while reducing costs.

Strategic Management and Business Analysis:This course offers frameworks and models for analyzing competitive challenges and strategic decisions. Integrating knowledge from previous modules and case studies, students gain a comprehensive understanding of strategic management and decision-making.

Advanced Business Theories:This module examines the intellectual evolution of business, transitioning from economics-based to behaviorally-driven approaches. Students engage with key articles and social science methods to understand the development of academic knowledge and contemporary research methodologies.

Global Financial Management:This module delves into asset valuation and financing principles in global financial markets. Topics include the time value of money, diversification and risk, and arbitrage and hedging, with practical applications in derivatives like bonds, stocks, and options. Risk mitigation strategies using financial instruments are also explored.

Organizational Behaviour:This module explores individual and group dynamics within organizations, focusing on organizational design, change, and inter-organizational relationships. Discussions and presentations highlight strategies for effective reorganization and behavior management.

Advanced Management:This module delves into advanced theories and practices in management, addressing organizational development, behavior dynamics, and leadership models. Students refine their understanding of communication, motivation, and strategic administration.

Segment 2 - RESEARCH/THESIS:

Here, you will produce an academic standard research report in this segment. This segment will last nominally for one-two year. Your specialization depends on the topic you will select for the research.

Doctor Of Philosophy (PhD) In Business Administration

The 180 ECTS DBA in Business Administration program equips business students, managers, practitioners, and leaders with advanced knowledge, research capabilities, and analytical skills to address complex organizational challenges. Unlike other advanced programs, this DBA emphasizes the application of theoretical concepts to practical business issues, fostering transformative learning and enhanced research proficiency. Participants develop the ability to view business scenarios from innovative perspectives and apply research methodologies to devise solutions that promote organizational growth, efficiency, and long-term sustainability.

This flexible and rigorous program is delivered entirely online, allowing students to progress at their own pace. Depending on their chosen pathway—Coursework or Research—students typically complete the program within three years. However, research-focused candidates may achieve their qualification in less than three years.

The DBA program emphasizes applied research, enabling participants to implement their learning directly into their organizational contexts. The curriculum is designed to develop critical skills, including research proficiency, analytical thinking, effective communication, presentation techniques, and leadership in change management.
After completing the program, students will have the ability to:
Develop qualitative and quantitative research skills essential for doctoral-level investigations.
Apply effective strategies for managing human resources in complex organizational settings.
Analyze and address competitive challenges using strategic management frameworks.
Explore the evolution of business theories and their application to contemporary practices.
Master principles of asset valuation, risk diversification, and financial risk mitigation.
Evaluate individual and group behaviours to optimize organizational performance.
Enhance leadership, communication, and motivation skills for strategic management success.
Course Details
The course is delivered in two segments. Segment 1 consists of Seven modules, each one with an assignment and Segment 2 consists of a RESEARCH REPORT(paper) Segment 1:
Modules: You will be awarded a level 8 Diploma for the completion of the coursework of the following modules.
Advanced Research Methods:

This module equips students with essential qualitative and quantitative research principles for doctoral-level studies. It covers theoretical concepts such as research philosophy and approach, alongside practical methods like research strategy, data collection, and analysis. Ethical research practices are emphasized to ensure sound decision-making throughout the doctoral process.

Advanced Human Resource Management:Focused on managing human capital in complex organizations, this module covers recruitment, training, promotion, and motivation strategies. It aims to enhance individual contributions, foster employee loyalty, and improve operational efficiency while reducing costs.

Strategic Management and Business Analysis:This course offers frameworks and models for analyzing competitive challenges and strategic decisions. Integrating knowledge from previous modules and case studies, students gain a comprehensive understanding of strategic management and decision-making.

Advanced Business Theories:This module examines the intellectual evolution of business, transitioning from economics-based to behaviorally-driven approaches. Students engage with key articles and social science methods to understand the development of academic knowledge and contemporary research methodologies.

Global Financial Management:This module delves into asset valuation and financing principles in global financial markets. Topics include the time value of money, diversification and risk, and arbitrage and hedging, with practical applications in derivatives like bonds, stocks, and options. Risk mitigation strategies using financial instruments are also explored.

Organizational Behaviour:This module explores individual and group dynamics within organizations, focusing on organizational design, change, and inter-organizational relationships. Discussions and presentations highlight strategies for effective reorganization and behavior management.

Advanced Management:This module delves into advanced theories and practices in management, addressing organizational development, behavior dynamics, and leadership models. Students refine their understanding of communication, motivation, and strategic administration.

Doctor Of Philosophy (PhD) In Business Administration
The 180 ECTS DBA in Business Administration program equips business students, managers, practitioners, and leaders with advanced knowledge, research capabilities, and analytical skills to address complex organizational challenges. Unlike other advanced programs, this DBA emphasizes the application of theoretical concepts to practical business issues, fostering transformative learning and enhanced research proficiency. Participants develop the ability to view business scenarios from innovative perspectives and apply research methodologies to devise solutions that promote organizational growth, efficiency, and long-term sustainability.
This flexible and rigorous program is delivered entirely online, allowing students to progress at their own pace. Depending on their chosen pathway—Coursework or Research—students typically complete the program within three years. However, research-focused candidates may achieve their qualification in less than three years.
The DBA program emphasizes applied research, enabling participants to implement their learning directly into their organizational contexts. The curriculum is designed to develop critical skills, including research proficiency, analytical thinking, effective communication, presentation techniques, and leadership in change management.
After completing the program, students will have the ability to:
Develop qualitative and quantitative research skills essential for doctoral-level investigations.
Apply effective strategies for managing human resources in complex organizational settings.
Analyze and address competitive challenges using strategic management frameworks.
Explore the evolution of business theories and their application to contemporary practices.
Master principles of asset valuation, risk diversification, and financial risk mitigation.
Evaluate individual and group behaviours to optimize organizational performance.
Enhance leadership, communication, and motivation skills for strategic management success.

Participants develop the ability to view business scenarios from innovative perspectives and apply research methodologies to devise solutions that promote organizational growth, efficiency, and long-term sustainability.

This flexible and rigorous program is delivered entirely online, allowing students to progress at their own pace. Depending on their chosen pathway—Coursework or Research—students typically complete the program within three years. However, research-focused candidates may achieve their qualification in less than three years.

The DBA program emphasizes applied research, enabling participants to implement their learning directly into their organizational contexts. The curriculum is designed to develop critical skills, including research proficiency, analytical thinking, effective communication, presentation techniques, and leadership in change management.
After completing the program, students will have the ability to:
Develop qualitative and quantitative research skills essential for doctoral-level investigations.
Apply effective strategies for managing human resources in complex organizational settings.
Analyze and address competitive challenges using strategic management frameworks.
Explore the evolution of business theories and their application to contemporary practices.
Master principles of asset valuation, risk diversification, and financial risk mitigation.
Evaluate individual and group behaviours to optimize organizational performance.
Enhance leadership, communication, and motivation skills for strategic management success.

The curriculum is designed to develop critical skills, including research proficiency, analytical thinking, effective communication, presentation techniques, and leadership in change management.
